description.p: Audio Labs Pro is a modern, responsive voice audio workstation built in Rust. It combines non-destructive multitrack audio editing with local speech synthesis, voice cloning, automated transcription, speech cleanup DSP, and an undoable session engine.

ul.li: Sample-accurate multitrack editing, crossfades, volume envelopes, and rippled deletes
Real-time voice cleanup DSP: high-pass filter, parametric EQ, de-hum, de-click, compressor, and limiter
Integrated Voice Lab with built-in neural TTS synthesis and script editor
Local voice dictation and clip transcription with SRT and WebVTT exports
Consent-gated voice profiling, reference quality auditing, and A/B acoustic comparison
Liquid-smooth GPU interface with dynamic glass themes and Wayland support

description.p: Audio Labs Pro 1.0.0 release: production-ready multitrack editing, complete voice DSP chain, TTS, STT dictation, voice profiles, and packaging.
Voice profiles, cloning consent gate, reference audio quality auditing, and prompt-based voice design.
Built-in acoustic TTS, script mode stitching, and offline dictation transcription.
Initial release: multitrack timeline, mixer, DSP effects chain, and WAV/FLAC/MP3 export.
First published GitHub release: seven-workspace studio shell with per-workspace cyberpunk neon accents, rectangular buttons, GPU waveform, and Linux packaging (deb, rpm, AppImage, Flatpak).

Security and correctness hardening across voice bundles, capture recovery, export rendering and the automation sandbox, plus a studio UI polish pass: uniform panel cards, pressed button states, grouped inspector actions and mono-digit time readouts.
